🔺 HanoiTower

Discs stacked on one peg must be moved to another peg, one disc at a time, never placing a larger disc on a smaller one. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Move one disc at a time between pegs.
  2. A larger disc can never be placed on top of a smaller disc.
  3. Move all discs from the source peg to the target peg.
  4. For n discs, the minimum solution is 2^n - 1 moves.
  5. Break the problem down: move n-1 discs, move the largest, repeat.
